deviations.claim_in_article: “A call seemed to come from an AI agent. But as the conversation went on, the voice was not AI at all. It was a person.” The article then says Meta’s test “caused exactly this surprise.”
deviations.issue: The opening presents an actual recipient’s mistaken belief and discovery, and says the test caused that surprise. The Ledger confirms that some Muse calls were made by human contract workers and that the test lacked appropriate disclosure, but does not report that a recipient actually experienced this surprise.
deviations.explanation: The assertion that a recipient actually discovered a human caller and that the test caused this surprise adds an unreported event and causal claim. “Seemed” qualifies how the call appeared to be placed, not whether a recipient experienced the stated surprise.
deviations.qualifier_text: “A call seemed to come from an AI agent.”
